description: Sisense callable names found inside JAQL formula strings. `safe` rows are same-argument-order token rewrites; `flag` rows are recognized but require grouping, ordering, filter-scope, or multipass semantics that this compositional parser cannot safely infer; `unsupported` is the fail-closed unknown-function contract. jaql_expr.py derives its runtime safe and flag maps from these rows. Date levels and expression/context composition remain code because they are not flat function-name mappings.
